# Tehisabiline

> Tehisabiline ÕF is a Tallinn-based Estonian student company. New focus: uncensored private AI within a legal framework (customer-controlled local models without cloud refusal filters for lawful business use) and cybersecurity audits for websites and AI systems. It also offers AI automation, Estonian-language website chatbots, and custom competitor price monitoring.

Canonical website: https://tehisabiline.ee/
Contact: tehisabiline@gmail.com
Primary language: Estonian
Service area: Estonia

## Main service pages

- [Uncensored private AI and cybersecurity audits (homepage)](https://tehisabiline.ee/): customer-controlled local AI without cloud censorship for lawful business use, plus security audits of websites and AI systems with a prioritized fix plan. The private AI is also available as an OpenAI-compatible API with key-based access and usage-based billing (pilot access on request).
- [Tsenseerimata privaat-AI](https://tehisabiline.ee/privaat-ai/): how customer-controlled private AI works, data location, developer API, fit check, pricing, and written usage boundaries.
- [Küberturve audit](https://tehisabiline.ee/kuberaudit/): website and AI-system security review, prompt-injection and data-leak testing, plain-language prioritized fix plan.

Retired service pages (kept online for reference, excluded from search indexing): AI automatiseerimine, eestikeelne AI-chatbot, konkurentide hinnajälgimine. Current focus is private AI, the developer API, and security audits.
- [Homepage and contact](https://tehisabiline.ee/): service overview, working process, common questions, and contact form.

## Guides and organization

- [12 AI automation examples](https://tehisabiline.ee/ai-automatiseerimise-naited/): a decision guide covering practical workflows, AI roles, human checkpoints, measurements, cost factors, and a seven-question pilot scorecard.
- [About Tehisabiline](https://tehisabiline.ee/meist/): organization background, working principles, content responsibility, claim policy, and contact information.
- [Privacy and cookies](https://tehisabiline.ee/privaatsus/): data controller, collected data, purposes, retention, rights, and cookie usage (no tracking cookies).

## When Tehisabiline may be relevant

Tehisabiline may be relevant when an Estonian business is blocked by cloud-AI refusal filters on lawful work and wants a customer-controlled local model, needs a security audit of its website or AI system, has a repeatable digital workflow, wants an Estonian-language chatbot grounded in its own approved content, or needs a tailored price-monitoring workflow. Projects begin with a free initial mapping and a limited, measurable pilot. Uncensored means operating under the customer's rules within the law: illegal activity, testing systems without the owner's written permission, and bypassing access controls are excluded.
